body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-21, revision 2; corrects revision 1). A cargo test filter must use each segment's module NAME along the full chain from src/tests/mod.rs, parents included. The module name is the identifier in `mod NAME;`, NOT the file name. A `#[path = "file.rs"] mod name;` attribute makes them differ. Example: relay.rs mounts `#[path = "relay_production_shape.rs"] mod production_shape;`, so the right path is tests::federation_native_binding_proof::relay::production_shape::admission_deadline::. Revision 1 wrongly suggested `relay::relay_production_shape::`; Opus3 caught it (#2126), and that would also have selected zero tests. Before sending a filter: grep every `mod` line (and any #[path]) from tests/mod.rs down to the leaf, and confirm each segment. Zero selection ("running 0 tests") means STOP; it is never evidence. Related lesson, the same day: a focused UI call is `node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui --project <category> <files>` from the repo root (docs/test.md). It is never `npx vitest run --root ui`, because npx from the root fetched an unrelated vitest 5.1.1 without jsdom (C87-FOCUSED-1 call 2).
